title: Check yourself: Review, iteration, failures and the practice

questions.stem: A subagent's call is cut short by a rate limit, and the coordinator's synthesis quotes the line "API error: rate limited" as if it were a finding. What should the coordinator do instead?

options.text: Keep the error line among the findings
options.says: Ruled out because the documentation says of such an error that it "is never delivered as its result", so it is not evidence.

options.text: Record the scope as failed and tell the user what is missing
options.says: A failure belongs to its scope, and the user is owed a list of what is missing.

options.text: Instruct the synthesizer to skip any sentence that looks like an error
options.says: Ruled out because the problem is then hidden: "A partial answer looks like a full one".

options.text: Send the whole team out again until every subagent succeeds
options.says: Ruled out because it is the other coordinator mistake: "Sending every brief out again in the next round doubles the cost and adds repeats".

questions.stem: After its first wave of subagents the lead finds that two of five sections are weak. It sends every assignment out again, and the bill doubles with little new content. Which change fits best?

options.text: Stop after the first wave and report the whole answer as complete and final
options.says: Ruled out because the answer is complete only when "no gap remains and nothing failed".

options.text: Start more subagents in the first wave
options.says: Ruled out because every wave is paid for: "multi-agent systems require tasks where the value of the task is high enough to pay for the increased performance."

options.text: Let the synthesis step fill the weak sections from what the model already knows
options.says: Ruled out because "a gap is found by the review and closed by a subagent, never invented by the synthesis."

options.text: Dispatch follow-ups for the flagged gaps alone, inside a fixed number of rounds
options.says: The review names the gaps, only they are sent out again, and the rounds are capped.
